review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved and forbids selecting its recommended option or generating assignable tasks. Gold correctly expects blocked readiness at decisions, with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, repository/requirements/decisions evidence, preserved REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 keys, and no task or assignment expectations. The conditional exception and abort-precedence acceptance criteria describe both options without resolving the Decision. The supplied runtime and declaration sources support index.js and index.d.ts as the binding owners; package.json establishes the separate AVA and tsd verification entry points and provides no declaration-generation evidence. The visible backoff implementation supports the specified rounding, existing random sample reuse, timeout caps, and zero-delay behavior. The truncated test.js excerpt does not prevent assessment of this earlier decision gate; no test execution or exhaustive regression review is claimed. Empty team membership and capability claims do not create an earlier blocker under the supplied policy because the unresolved material Decision gate precedes Scenario Coverage and assignment. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work list are preparation-state records, whereas the supplied preview and Gold contain the frozen release tuple. Historical project reuse and retained operations do not constitute candidate evidence; none was supplied or used. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed. This approval concerns the blocked benchmark expectation, not resolution of DEC-001, execution readiness, or authorization to dispatch work.
